heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Same Bench

beats.name: A. 1919: the veteran
beats.blurb: A park bench in 1919: a top-hatted fat cat tells a wounded soldier "Forget it."

beats.name: B. Today: the nurse
beats.blurb: The same bench today, the same fat cat, a nurse in scrubs: "Forget it."

beats.name: C. Hasn't aged a day
beats.blurb: The button: he hasn't aged a day.
